nodes.text: Nick leads Denni to the back of the classroom. He glances around carefully, takes a key off a chain around his neck, and slides it into the lock of the office's supply closet...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: One of the perks of being the head of the newspaper club... You can do whatever you want with the space.

Nick throws open the door... Revealing a massive chart against the back wall! It's covered in photos of guys at Spartan connected with bits of string! Notes are written all over it: 'Immortal?'... 'Poseidon'... 'Initiation Ceremony'...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've been investigating the Immortals for the last three months. At first, it was just rumors and gossip, whispers of a secret society...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then I noticed that certain students seemed to get special privileges... Privileges they did nothing to earn.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When I tried to dig deeper, I found myself blocked at every turn. My room was broken into and vandalized. I got threatened in the hallway. And when I went to the administration, they turned a blind eye.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whatever is happening here... It goes straight to the top.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Dude... You're `hardcore.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]hardcore.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm just a journalist doing my job.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoever these Immortals are, they're trouble... And based on what I've figured out, I think they're planning something devious!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what do we do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've been at a dead-end in my investigation for a while... But now that you're here, I think we might be able to crack the case!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh? How's that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, for starters... You'd be amazed what the guys around here will do for a `pretty face.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, for starters... You'd be amazed what the guys around here will do for a [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty face.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean... Me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I... It's just... You know...
Denni steps forward and examines Nick's board. She looks from photo to photo of Spartan guys...
Before stopping at a photo of Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's Colt Warren. The newest member of the Immortals. I can't even begin to understand how he fits into their order...
Denni reaches up and touches the photo with one hand. Nick notices.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You, uh... You know him?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I used to...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But now? I'm not so sure.
Nick freezes. He stares at Denni with a guarded, suspicious expression...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...And what, exactly, do you know about The Immortals?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, not much... I know they're a secret society based out of Spartan Academy... I know most of the school's most influential students are a part of it... I think the school's administration might be involved...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And you just happened to figure this out?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No one else put you up to this?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're not a spy sent to seduce me and steal my work?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Is that a possibility?
Nick doesn't say anything for a moment, but squints intensely at Denni...
Then breaks into a smile!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So you figured all that stuff about the Immortals on your own, huh? Brendan wasn't kidding when he said you were a top-notch journalist!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He said that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He spoke very highly of you, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What else did he tell you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Only that you were worried about a friend of yours and suspected that he'd got mixed up with The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And that I can trust you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You can.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Right. Now, look... I appreciate you coming right out and telling me what you're looking for. It's a good way to build trust...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But you can't just go blabbing so openly about The Immortals. The walls have ears... Or possibly surveillance devices.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Seriously. Follow me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...Really? Why would you care about that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I, uh, just thought it might be something the Centerscore students want to read about... You know, a comparison piece...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... That might not be the best idea...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look, the tensions between our two schools are pretty high already...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How do you think the students at your school will react when they hear about the world-class chef in our cafeteria or the state-of-the-art media lab or the yearly trip to Switzerland?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You guys take a yearly trip to Switzerland?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: See? Releasing an article like that would be fomenting class warfare!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, but I just can't be a part of this. Brendan said you had some major personal story to investigate, but this... This is just irresponsible.
Nick turns back to his desk. Denni sighs and steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, Nick, hold on... I... I might not have been entirely honest with you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The truth is... I'm investigating The Immortals.
Nick freezes. He turns towards Denni slowly, craning an eyebrow.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And what, `exactly,` do you know about The Immortals?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what, [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly,[/i][/color] do you know about The Immortals?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not much, okay? I just know that my friend has gotten involved with them, and he's changed, and I think he's in trouble, and... And I just need to make sure he's okay!
Nick squints at Denni intensely... Then shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay. That's much better. I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I wish you'd come out and been honest with me from the beginning.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... The truth is... I didn't know if I could trust you. Maybe you were... You know... One of them.
Nick mulls this over... Then smiles.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good instinct. Now follow me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'I've been researching these so-called Immortals. I can't find much, but... I have a really bad feeling about this whole thing.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'If you could meet with me, just for a few minutes... It would really mean a lot.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'Let me know...'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'Denni.'
Denni stares at the email for a minute... Then sighs and hits 'Send'!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I really hope he takes it well...
Just then, the door swings open. Brendan walks in and settles down.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Denni! What're you up to in here? Working on an article?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, kind of, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know how you can focus. I'm still so drained from the SETs this morning...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah... Those...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How do you think you did?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not great, to be honest... I was kind of distracted...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: By this story? I appreciate your dedication to the club, but honestly, the SETs are way more important.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I still have two more years before I'm applying to college, so I'm not really worried...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's not just about that, you know. Thanks to the Mayor's `Sprint to the Top` program, the school with the highest average SET scores gets a huge endowment!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not just about that, you know. Thanks to the Mayor's [color=#e23b3b][i]Sprint to the Top[/i][/color] program, the school with the highest average SET scores gets a huge endowment!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And believe me, we need it...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, things aren't `that` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, things aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you kidding? The last issue of the newspaper was printed on lined notebook paper that we fished out of the trash cans! Half the pages were covered in Ryan's doodles...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And they were... Graphic...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I mean, just look at that computer you're using! Talk about a piece of cutting-edge Cold War technology!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If Centerscore did better on its SETs... Maybe we'd get the money we need to improve the school!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So it's my fault Centerscore isn't going to get the funding it needs? Thanks for the guilt trip, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, sorry... Standardized testing always makes me... Well... Testy...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you think that's where the word comes from? I should look into that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hard-hitting journalism from Centerscore's best sleuth!
Just then, Denni's computer beeps! She turns to it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh, that's weird... Colt doesn't usually reply to emails that quickly... Or at all...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's see what he has to say...
Denni opens the email and starts reading it...

nodes.speaker: Email
nodes.text: Look, Denni, I'm just going to say this once... Back off and leave me alone.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'I know you're going through a lot of personal issues or whatever, but that doesn't give you the right to just blow everyone off!'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'What you did to the Centerscore football field was seriously not okay... And it's been really hard to lie and pretend like I don't know who did it.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'After everything we've been through, you can't just cut me out.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmmm... I hope I'm not being too hard on him... He did claim he was trying to be a better person...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Then again... Maybe what he needs most is a little tough love to get his head straight.
Denni resumes writing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'What I'm saying is, we need to talk. You owe me that much.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'I know things haven't ever been exactly normal between us... But the truth is, I really care about you... And I know you care about me too.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'That kiss we shared... That was one of the most amazing moments of my life. I think about it from time to time, and I... I...'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmmm... I hope I'm not coming on too strong. Colt's never been the overly emotional type...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Then again... He's closed himself off so much... Maybe what he needs is to hear some real emotional truth.'
Denni resumes typing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'What I'm saying, Colt, is that I want to talk to you. I `need` to talk to you.'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'What I'm saying, Colt, is that I want to talk to you. I [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] to talk to you.'

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'It might not be my place to say anything... But the last time I saw you, you didn't seem like yourself.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'I know you've had a rough year. I know you've been through a lot. Whatever happened to you in San Francisco seems like it made a pretty big impression on you...'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'But what you're doing now... Going to Spartan... Joining some secret society... It just doesn't seem right.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'If it's really what you want, then that's fine but... I just want to know what's going through your head.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'Please, Colt... I just want to talk.'
Denni stares up at the light and exercises all her will not to sneeze...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on, come on, `come on...!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, come on, [color=#3b78e2][i]come on...![/i][/color]

nodes.text: For one moment, she feels like it's impossible...
But then the urge passes!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Phew!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Phew![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick shoots Denni a nervous thumbs up...
When Percy turns around and walks right back to the closet!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ugh... I swear, Chad's stench is contagious. I need a change of clothes...
Denni gasps. Nick grabs her hand. Percy walks right up to the closet door and reaches down...
Mark sits up on the bench and pats the spot next to him. Denni sits down and leans in real close...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So... I don't suppose `you` have a date to the Cotillion?
nodes.text_bbcode: So... I don't suppose [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] have a date to the Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah. As a matter of fact, I do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Well, not yet exactly... But I will...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Won't I, `Percy?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Won't I, [color=#e23b3b][i]Percy?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The sound of someone softly clapping reverberates from the far side of the room! Denni spins around to see Percy standing against a wall!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well done, Marcus. Well done.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And yes... I do believe something I can arrange something for you with my contacts at Monarch.
Denni shoots up. She looks frantically at Nick, who throws up his hands in confusion.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You see, I got word earlier today that there was a very suspicious girl snooping around campus... Flirting insincerely with fools... Breaking into people's rooms...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And associating with a certain Boy Wonder journalist with an affinity for black clothing.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Boy Wonder? I'll have to remember that.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Laugh all you want. For all your cleverness, I was onto you all day... You and your strange, little girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, no, I'm not his girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Please, spare me the 'will they, won't they' garbage. I've got your number, plain and simple.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! He's got your number! Booyah!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mark... You were in on this all along?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Percy sent a school-wide email saying we should keep an eye out for you and text him if we saw you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So this whole time we were flirting...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I was stalling for time! Boo... `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was stalling for time! Boo... [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And in exchange, you, what... Get to be an Immortal?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Heck yeah!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There! The Immortals! You admitted they exist!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Do you really still not get it, Nicolas? It doesn't matter what I admit... If you don't have proof.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: After all... Who's going to take your word against mine?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...No one.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Exactly. So from now on, please do me a favor and stay out of my sight. And as for your oddball girlfriend...
Percy leans up close to Denni, the musk of his cologne overwhelming...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You have exactly five minutes to get off this campus. I'd recommend you get moving.
Denni struggles to think of something to say, but can't find the words. She glances at Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, Denni... But he's got us. We lost.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think it'd be best if we just do what he says.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... Right.
Denni steps out onto the quad and sadly walks back to the parking lot.
As she steps out the heavy iron gates of the school, she turns around...
And for just one second, sees Colt! He's surrounded by several Spartan guys, and he's laughing as they stroll together across campus...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!
But just as Colt turns to see who called for him, the iron gate slams shut between them, cutting Denni off. She stands there sadly for a few minutes... Wipes a tear...
And walks away.
Talk about tragic! That ending was a total downer!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I realize now that you really care about him... Care enough to do `whatever` it takes to make sure he's okay...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I realize now that you really care about him... Care enough to do [color=#e23b3b][i]whatever[/i][/color] it takes to make sure he's okay...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And that includes getting some sleazeball Spartan junior to take me to the dance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Afraid so.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right... But if he tries anything funny, I'm punching his lights out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now `that` I want to see!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] I want to see!

nodes.text: A few minutes later, Denni and Nick walk into the Spartan weight room, where several guys are working out...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Your best bet is the guy over by the bench press. Mark Backbutter. One of the only Spartan upperclassmen who doesn't have a date...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why? Is he, like, shady or something? We've got this guy like that at Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, his date just dumped him a few days ago. He should be `seriously` vulnerable...
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, his date just dumped him a few days ago. He should be [color=#e23b3b][i]seriously[/i][/color] vulnerable...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, now `I` just feel shady!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, now [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] just feel shady!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If it's any consolation, he once tried to cheat off me on a bio test, and when I said no, he stole my backpack and threw it in a dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That is a consolation, actually.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now remember... Only girls from Monarch Prep are allowed at the Cotillion.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If you're going to get Mark to ask you out, you're going to have to convince him you're a Monarch Prep girl.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So... Rich, stuck-up, with an inflated sense of self-worth?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Think you can pull it off?
Denni grins and flips her hair over her shoulder with a confident flick of her head.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Darling...` You have no idea what I'm capable of!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Darling...[/i][/color] You have no idea what I'm capable of!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me... I have to go work my magic.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just one thing...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Which one is the bench press?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The one over there... You know... With the bench?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Clever.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good luck!
Denni walks over to the bench press, where Mark is doing reps...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Five... Unfff... Six...
He glances up and sees Denni...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh... Six `hundred` and one... Six `hundred` and two...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Six [color=#e23b3b][i]hundred[/i][/color] and one... Six [color=#e23b3b][i]hundred[/i][/color] and two...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey there, tough guy... Looks like you're pumping pretty hard...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I like to stay fit. What's a pretty thing like you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, I just wanted to stop by and see how all you strapping Spartan boys were doing...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Heh. I'm Mark.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh... Well... This is awkward...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry! Do you already have a date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, no...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But you have a girl you're hoping to ask to be your date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, that's not it either...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, if you're embarrassed to even have me as your fake date, then why don't you just come right out and say it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? No! It's not like that at all!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: See... I'm a sophomore.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, what? Why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Only upperclassmen are allowed to attend the Cotillion as guests. Underclassmen have to work the event. I'll be serving appetizers.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously? They make you guys work the big dance? This is the worst school ever!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know, I didn't even think it was that bad until you just pointed it out...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hmmm... That's a pretty good idea...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course it's a good idea. I'm an awesome journalist, remember?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're not bad. The only problem is the school doesn't hire much outside staff... Most of the jobs at the dance are worked by underclassmen. You know, so the upperclassmen can enjoy themselves.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously? Worst school ever...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That doesn't mean we can't find `some` job to get you in ... You know a few years ago, the Cotillion had a disco theme, and they had these go-go dancers...
nodes.text_bbcode: That doesn't mean we can't find [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] job to get you in ... You know a few years ago, the Cotillion had a disco theme, and they had these go-go dancers...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't go-go `or` dance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I don't go-go [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] dance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think they hire outside valets...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No driver's license.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't suppose you play any musical instruments...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sometimes I sing in the shower...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hmmm... We're running low on options but... How do you feel about dressing up as a boy?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...A boy?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Too Shakespearian?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Too curvy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Touche.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I seriously can't, like, serve appetizers or something?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually... Yours truly is on appetizer duty.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's the big dance, right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Exactly. It's the biggest social event of the year.
When his phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You have got to be kidding me!
Percy turns around and flips open his phone...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hello? What? No, Chad, you idiot, not `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello? What? No, Chad, you idiot, not [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Tonight! During the Cotillion!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Yes! That's the whole point!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Just... Just sit tight. I'll be right there to explain it in person.
Percy snaps his phone shut and storms out. Denni and Nick sit tight, barely breathing, for one minute to make sure he's gone...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's move?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's move!
Nick and Denni scramble out of the closet and rush down the stairs and out the door...
And out onto the Spartan Quad!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... That was close...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Too close. I'm sorry, Denni, I... I got carried away.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's fine. At least we got one major lead out of it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whatever the Immortals are planning, they're going to do it during the Cotillion!
Denni rocks back and lets out a loud, eruptive sneeze!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Ah-choo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ah-choo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: What the...?
Percy spins around and stalks towards the closet. You grab Nick's hand!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know! You're the one that sneezed!
The closet doors fly open! Denni and Nick find themselves face-to-face with Percy!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Surprise! Closet inspection!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Closet inspection.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes sir! And I have to say you passed with flying colors! Good organization, minimal clutter, and a great sense of feng shui!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now if you don't mind, we'll just be on our way and...
Percy grabs Denni's shoulders as she heads out the door.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Not so fast, you remarkably strange girl...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I may not be the most-well versed in American customs, but I know well enough that there is no such thing as a `closet inspection!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I may not be the most-well versed in American customs, but I know well enough that there is no such thing as a [color=#e23b3b][i]closet inspection![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He swivels towards Nick.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And who do we have here? Nicolas Brown, Spartan's most slippery sleuth.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Let me guess... This is another attempt to crack the case of this mythical secret society you're always talking about!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The Immortals are real, and you know it!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Tell me, do you also believe in Santa Claus and kangaroos and the Easter Bunny?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: One of those things is not like the others...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All right, Percy, you got us, okay? Now report us to Headmaster Moriarty and get it over with.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Actually... I won't be taking this to the Headmaster.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You won't?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No, you see... This building is technically speaking the residence of Ichstenborg monarchy...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Which makes it, according to the fine print, an embassy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You see... You are currently illegal immigrants, trespassing on Ichstenborg soil.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And that means I have no choice but to leave this matter to a `higher` authority!
nodes.text_bbcode: And that means I have no choice but to leave this matter to a [color=#e23b3b][i]higher[/i][/color] authority!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...So the headmaster?
Two weeks later, Denni and Nick stand side-by-side...
Facing the Grand High Inquisitor of Ichstenborg!

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Now then! Let us begin the trials of Nicolas Brown and the bafflingly-named Denni Fallon.

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: I mean, come on, what kind of a name is that? 'Denni'?

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Perhaps your mother could not decide between Denise and Annie, and so she decided to combine them!
Around the Inquisitor, the High Council of Ichstenborg guffaws uproariously.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's not even a good joke...

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: The joke is that your mother's an idiot.

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Ahem! The two of you stand accused of fourteen separate high felonies!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Fourteen? Wait, what?!

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Let us see... There's 'Trespassing'... 'Breaking and Entering'... 'Unlawful Entry'...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Those are all terms for the same thing...

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: And eleven charges of 'Aggravating a Ranking Member of the Ichstenborg Monarchy'... The gravest crime imaginable!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm guessing you charge a lot of people with that, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: We have some of the most well-stocked labor camps in the world, yes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, if I could just begin arguing in our defense, we had no idea we...

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: What? No, you do not get to 'argue in your defense'? What a ridiculous notion! Let us all guffaw at this stupid girl!
The rest of the council hoots and hollers!

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Do you know nothing of Ichstenborg justice? A monarch accuses you of a crime, and then I sentence you to hard labor! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Does the UN know about this?

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Silence! For your grand crimes and misdemeanors, I sentence you to ten years in our famed barium mines!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Isn't barium poisonous?

nodes.speaker: Inquisitor
nodes.text: Only if you have a central nervous system! Have fun!
Well, you probably don't need us to tell you that this is `not` the correct ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you probably don't need us to tell you that this is [b]not[/b] the correct ending!

nodes.text: Try again, and see if you can do better!
Denni has failed.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now, that could be some kind of an Immortal nickname...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or it could just be a Spartan guy thing, I don't know, you guys have this weird Greek mythology fixation going on...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Either way, it's a great lead. I've always had my suspicions about Percy...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He sounds pretty suspicious. For starters, his name is `Percy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He sounds pretty suspicious. For starters, his name is [color=#3b78e2][i]Percy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Follow me.
Nick leads Denni across the Spartan quad.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: His real name is Percival von Guttentag. He's the Crown-Prince of Ichstenborg.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ichstenborg... Is that the tiny European nation famous for their cheese and smuggling?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Clocks and tax havens, but close enough.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sounds pretty rich. Let me guess... He's got the fanciest dorm room?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... He doesn't stay in the dorms...
Nick and Denni round a corner and come upon a huge, luxury condo on the edge of campus!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He lives `there.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He lives [color=#e23b3b][i]there.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He has his own condo?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With... Fountains? And balconies? And a gazebo?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that a `helicopter` on the roof?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is that a [color=#3b78e2][i]helicopter[/i][/color] on the roof?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Still yup.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This school is `ridiculous!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This school is [color=#3b78e2][i]ridiculous![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, well, wait 'til you see the inside.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We're going inside?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course! How else are we gonna snoop around?
Nick walks up and knocks on the door. No one answers.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What now?
With a grin, Nick pulls a key out of his pocket and unlocks the door!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You have the key to Percy's condo?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Technically, it's a key to everything on campus. I swiped it off a groundskeeper.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You stole a master key?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa! How did you know how to do that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What kind of a journalist would I be if I couldn't get into locked buildings?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: An... Ethical one?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look, do you wanna find out what The Immortals are up to or not? Come on!
Nick steps inside and makes his way upstairs to Percy's bedroom. Denni nervously follows him...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, I... I don't think we should be doing this... It doesn't really seem right...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can go if you want. I'll be out in a sec. I just need to see if I can find anything...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm `sure` there's something incriminating here somewhere...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]sure[/i][/color] there's something incriminating here somewhere...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on, Nick, we don't even know for sure if he's a member of The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then we won't find anything, and we'll be on our way.
Nick cocks his head and looks at Denni.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look, if you're really uncomfortable, we can...
Just then, Nick is cut off by the sound of the door downstairs swinging open!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no!
The sound of lumbering footsteps approaches them, thundering up the stairs!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Hide!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hide![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick and Denni scramble frantically for cover, before ducking into a closet! They slam the door shut, just as Percy steps in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hfff... Hfff...
Pressed up right against Denni, Nick speaks in an urgent whisper...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whatever you do... Don't make any noise...
Denni leans forward and peaks through the crack in the door. Percy steps into his room and yawns...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ugh. It `is` amazing how much of my day I have to spend dealing with imbeciles...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] amazing how much of my day I have to spend dealing with imbeciles...

nodes.text: Denni tries as hard as she can to stay quiet... But the thick smell of Percy's cologne sets her nose twitching!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no... Not now... Please not now... Please don't sneeze!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Percy?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, he took a call from him and then ran off...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But before he did, he referred to him as `Zeus.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But before he did, he referred to him as [color=#3b78e2][i]Zeus.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The Cotillion? Oh, that's this big fancy ball that's held every year between Spartan Academy and Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Usually it just ends in everyone making out, fighting, or crying.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sounds like my mom's first wedding...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's fancy and boring and usually kind of creepy... But I don't think it has much to do with The Immortals.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Think... Is there anything else?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Um... He took a call from someone named Percy... Who he referred to as 'Zeus'...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Listen. You're pretty weird, but you're also a girl, so you have my attention.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I've already got a date to the `Cotillion,` but maybe we can meet up afterwards...
nodes.text_bbcode: I've already got a date to the [color=#e23b3b][i]Cotillion,[/i][/color] but maybe we can meet up afterwards...

nodes.text: Chad's phone rings. He answers.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, `Percy.` I mean, Zeus. I mean, Percy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, [color=#e23b3b][i]Percy.[/i][/color] I mean, Zeus. I mean, Percy.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah. Sure thing. I'll be right there.
Chad walks off. Denni waits until he's gone and then walks back over to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now, come on, Chad... I'm sure a big, strong guy like you isn't afraid of anything!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Huh? No, I'm not! I look fear in the face, and then I spit!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I find that `incredibly` easy to believe...
nodes.text_bbcode: I find that [color=#3b78e2][i]incredibly[/i][/color] easy to believe...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, uh, well, if you're so brave, then you can't be afraid of some stupid rules!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So why don't you tell me more about this secret society?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm not gonna do that.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No offense, you're pretty cute, but I'm just not gonna risk it. I'm not `afraid,` really, but I'm in enough trouble with the rest of the guys as is...
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, you're pretty cute, but I'm just not gonna risk it. I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]afraid,[/i][/color] really, but I'm in enough trouble with the rest of the guys as is...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It's just not worth it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... Well... Um... Is there anything else we can talk about?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I dunno... You got any tape?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Cuz I'm `ripped!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Cuz I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]ripped![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You really know a lot of muscle jokes, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Jokes?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You... You know... What you've been saying?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, well then, I guess we really don't have much to talk about, do we?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll just be going...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait! Hold on! I... I'm sure there's more we can talk about!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know, Chad, I was `really` interested in that secret society... If you're not going to tell me more about it, maybe I'll go find someone who will...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, Chad, I was [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] interested in that secret society... If you're not going to tell me more about it, maybe I'll go find someone who will...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Someone with even `bigger` muscles...
nodes.text_bbcode: Someone with even [color=#3b78e2][i]bigger[/i][/color] muscles...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Who? `Who` has bigger muscles? Tell me! I'll kill him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who? [color=#e23b3b][i]Who[/i][/color] has bigger muscles? Tell me! I'll kill him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Although... His bigger muscles `will` give him an advantage...
nodes.text_bbcode: Although... His bigger muscles [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] give him an advantage...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right, then. See you later...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait! Don't go to some bigger-muscled man! I'll tell you what I can, okay?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We're called `The Immortals,` okay? And we're super-top-secret.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're called [color=#e23b3b][i]The Immortals,[/i][/color] okay? And we're super-top-secret.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The Immortals? What a cool and masculine name!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Heck yeah! There's six of us now...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Six, huh?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: There's this new guy, Colt, who totally sucks...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you saying he doesn't fit in? He's an outcast? He's just pretending to be into the society so he can take it down from within?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What? No? He just sucks because he's all crappy! He's always talking tough, and he doesn't respect his superiors or know his place!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sounds like Colt...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah...
Chad jerks up both his arms and flexes his bulging biceps!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: For bringing these `guns` to school!
nodes.text_bbcode: For bringing these [color=#e23b3b][i]guns[/i][/color] to school!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, you got any grain on you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? No...
Chad pulls up his pant-leg!

nodes.speaker: Chad
